normalizationChanges: Only copies used in the harness: set reportingCurrencyOriginal and tradingCurrency to USD, fxRateApplied to 1, fxConverted to true; financial numbers stay unchanged.
Only copies used in the harness: set statementPeriods[*].currency and existing price.currency to USD; original descriptors, currencyUnit and FX remain in old/candidate.

Keep source clocks and financial gaps; expire only the virtual FTS cache at 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z; no manual ticker or optional reload.
